about: Hearth's Proton detector table (docs/WINDOWS-APPS.md). Bundled with the image, never fetched live. Read by hosts/linux/desktop/shell/hearth_proton.py (Windows apps) and hosts/hearth-core/src/proton_pick.rs (Hearth Games). proton: 'builtin' (the GE-Proton built into Hearth OS), 'valve' (the newest Valve Proton Steam has installed), or a GE-Proton name from older_ge. match: exe (a Windows program's file name, * allowed, any case) or game (a Hearth Games id, store:id). winver/dxvk/vkd3d: what the program needs, used when you haven't set them yourself.
